title: Guards must not depend on insightSceneLogic.insightLogicRef (lags insightId/dashboardId)
answers: how to check whether the current scene is showing a given insight
is insightLogicRef safe to read right after scene mount
body:
insightSceneLogic.insightId and dashboardId are reducers updated synchronously by the URL-matching action; insightLogicRef is set later by a listener that rebuilds/mounts a logic, so it can be stale or null just after mount.
Enforced in frontend/src/scenes/insights/insightDataLogic.tsx:isInsightSceneInstance, which requires activeSceneId === Scene.Insight and insightId === props.dashboardItemId and (dashboardId ?? null) === (props.dashboardId ?? null).
If skipped: persistDisplayOptions may PATCH the insight while the editor is still in edit mode.
Tests: mock insightSceneLogic.findMounted returning { values: { insightId, dashboardId, insightLogicRef: null } } (see persistDisplayOptions describe in insightDataLogic.test.ts).
applies: Code reading insightSceneLogic state to decide scene/insight identity
